div.div:
One transaction per movement. The balance (Available = :read, retried up to 3 times), the ledger row (attribute_not_exists — the idempotency key) and a ConditionCheck of the warehouse. A replay is answered from the ledger before anything is decided (ADR-0052 §7).
Unique warehouse codes without a read: the CODE# guard goes in the same TransactWriteItems as the warehouse (§2).
Every resolver checks StockKeeper or Admin first; a Seller or a customer gets Unauthorized, reads included (§3).

text.tspan: One transaction per movement. The balance (Available = :read, retried up to 3 times), the ledger row (attribute_not_exists — the idempotency key) and a ConditionCheck of the
warehouse. A replay is answered from the ledger before anything is decided (ADR-0052 §7).
Unique warehouse codes without a read: the CODE# guard goes in the same TransactWriteItems as the warehouse (§2).
Every resolver checks StockKeeper or Admin first; a Seller or a customer gets Unauthorized, reads included (§3).
